evidence.summary: Read every changed card in full against its complete unchanged transcript. The sequence progresses from object/dimension scaffolding to topic synthesis, time qualification, evidence limits, and transfer. The learner can answer from front clues without playing audio. Reference answers, specific explanations and optional method hints replace repetitive Chinese-keyword guessing and generic warnings. A second assumption-inversion pass tested whether unfamiliar English or silent use invalidates each task; a failure-projection pass checked unsupported comparative, efficacy and completion claims. No blocking findings. This is text-content acceptance; audio bytes, transcript, source identity, interaction and ownership remain unchanged and no new perceptual audio claim is made.
